text:
dena-partners: Heads-up: MarlinAI sent a draft for their 7B/13B weights listing. They want both a hosted API SKU and a downloadable BYOW SKU with geo-restrictions and an escrow option for signed weights. Can we confirm a sequencing we can commit to?

sam-legal: High-level: hosted API is straightforward. For BYOW/download we need a redistribution addendum, escrow chain-of-custody, and export control vetting. Escrow terms must state release triggers and liability cap.

leo-solutions: From SI perspective we need an "installation bundle" for on-prem SIs: artifact tarball, manifest, detached signature(s), and an accompanying verification script. Also a short quant report if they advertise quantized performance.

dena-partners: Partner suggested an escrow provider and wants the escrow release to be tied to a signed addendum + proof-of-origin. They asked if geoblocking (EU-only download) is possible for the BYOW SKU.

sam-legal: Geoblocking is fine but must be reflected in the contract (territory clause). For escrow: require timestamped signed manifest and verifier instructions. Add warranty: partner maintains signature key audit logs for 18 months.

leo-solutions: Can we require an SPDX-like manifest with explicit provenance_chain? Example they sent (mock):

```
{
  "name": "marlin-7b",
  "version": "2026-04-02",
  "digest": "sha256:fa7c...",
  "provenance_chain": [
    {"artifact": "train-data.tar.gz", "source": "s3://marlin/data", "hash": "sha256:aaa..."}
  ],
  "signatures": [
    {"algo": "pgp", "key_id": "0xDEADBEEF", "sig_type": "detached", "sig_blob": "..."}
  ],
  "escrow_instruction": {"provider": "TrustVault","release_on": "addendum_signed"},
  "kms_refs": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444455556666:key/zzzz-1111"],
  "geo_restrictions": ["EU"]
}
```

leo-solutions: We'll map to our SI packaging spec.

nate-hw: For edge claims we need a validation run. HW SI can test quantized artifacts on EdgeBox v2 next week; need artifact URL + quant table. Also callout: some NIC firmware blocks mmap perf; will note in results.

dena-partners: Commercial ask from partner: 70/30 rev-share on paid downloads, 10% listing fee for hosted API usage. Want to announce jointly. Thoughts?

sam-legal: Commercials are negotiable. Need to put a limit on liability in addendum and require partner to indemnify for third-party provenance issues. Also escrow agreements must allow us to verify signatures without exposing key material.

leo-solutions: Ops note: Marketplaces support staged SKUs. Suggest we list hosted API Day 0, mark BYOW as "coming soon" with request-to-download gating until addendum & escrow proof are in place. That avoids leakage.

ops-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-4890 for MarlinAI BYOW gating and escrow integration  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-4890

nate-hw: I'll schedule EdgeBox validation and post a short perf summary. Prefer they push artifacts to our secure bucket.

sam-legal: Action items: I'll draft the addendum with redistribution + escrow clause (target Tue). Addendum will require: manifest schema, signature verification steps, escrow provider acceptance, geo clause, and liability cap.

dena-partners: Action items recap: Leo to prepare SI bundle template + verification snippet, Sam to draft addendum, Nate to confirm HW validation slot, I'll coordinate commercial threads with partner. We'll reconvene after artifacts + draft addendum land.

leo-solutions: Quick doc action: I'll add a README stub in docs repo with example verification commands (gpg --verify, sha256sum).

dena-partners: Thanks all  I'll post partner contact and expected delivery ETA in PARTNERS-4890 when available.
